Module com.example.cab302project
Package com.example.cab302project.model

Class GoalTemplate

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302project.model.GoalTemplate
public class GoalTemplate extends Object
A suggested starting point for a new goal. Templates prefill the goal creation form; the user can change anything before saving.

    • GoalTemplate

      public GoalTemplate(String title, Category category, CompletionType completionType, int target)
      Creates a goal template.
      Parameters:
      title - What the goal suggests doing.
      category - The wellbeing area this template belongs to.
      completionType - Whether it is worked towards or one and done.
      target - The value that must be reached to complete it.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any of the details are invalid.
